== Meeting the Man Himself ==
[[File:The founder in rockefeller .png|thumb|The Founder talks to Orion]]
[[Orion Richards (MC)|Orion]] comes face-to-face with the [[The Founder|Founder]] himself, along with two [[Praetorian|praetorians]], Four and Twelve. The Founder provides some insights, such as how Ulysses can only track who first finds a [[Gem of Doom]], and not those who take previously found gems. The Founder notes how he has kept on eye on Orion. He offers Orion the Amulet of Blair, something that he's offered other promising players to more quickly find the gems. The Founder explains that this amulet provides in-game immortality. Orion may either accept the gift, or refuse it. The Founder asks one last question of Orion, on his motivations, before leaving.  

After the Founder leaves, Orion reflects to himself for a moment before [[Alex Bardot|Alex]] finds him. Orion tries to explain the previous encounter, but Alex does not immediately believe him. She informs him that her father, [[William Bardot]], is making a speech and that this is a good time for them and [[Calypso]] to leave. Orion agrees, and decides to share his findings with the rest of the party after they have left. 

== Park Conversations ==
[[File:Alex, Dalia, and Penny on the bench.png|thumb|The Girls in the Park]]
After a few days pass, [[Alex Bardot|Alex]] is on a park bench talking through some recent events with her grandma, represented through her pendant. She notes her swimming activities, her time in Eternum, and Orion, noting the things she has begun to like about him. As she reflects, [[Dalia Carter|Dalia]] sneaks up behind her, interrupting her monologue. They talk back and forth, about opening up to each other, as Dalia was excited to talk about her time in her [[The Cove|private server]]. Alex is able to nudge some information out of her. [[Penelope Carter|Penelope]] arrives, passing by on her way to meet [[Nancy Carter|Nancy]]. After some small talk, Dalia notes that Penelope is dressing more suggestively than usual. She brushes it off as being just a cute outfit, but acknowledges that multiple other people, including Orion, are also meeting with Nancy. Dalia decides to join her, to Penelope's mild annoyance, and Alex departs.

== The Roof ==
Orion, [[Chang Wong|Chang]], Nancy, and [[Nova Johnson|Nova]] are all together at [[The Roof]]. Nancy is finishing up work while Nova is drawing something. The player can choose to look at her art while she departs to the bathroom. Annie then arrives, allowing Nancy to outline her plan: obtaining more Gems of Doom (potentially from [[Thanatos]]) and the final [[The Weapons of Atlas|Weapon of Atlas]], as well as investigating the Syndicate and Founder further. She assigns jobs to the various members of the group and asks Nova whether she could create a device that steals the inventory of any Eternum player, who answers that she's actively working on it. Nancy and Orion then go to pay for food. If the player is on Nancy's romance route, another scene almost plays in the restroom, but Dalia and Penelope show up before it can progress. They leave with their mother to go shopping.

== Day of the Dead ==
If the player agreed to celebrate Día de los Muertos with [[Luna Hernandez|Luna]] and [[Mr. Hernandez]]<nowiki/>r, they arrive in a car named Fiero to pick Orion up. Her father reveals that the drive is actually 10 hours long, and they'll be celebrating lunch tomorrow instead. The player can choose whether to continue (and whether to sit with Luna, which gains favor), though neither option will miss the costume party on Sunday. During the car ride, after a moment of discussing a local murderer, the player can play a game of "10 Questions" with Luna, a modified version of 20 Questions where instead the other player is thinking of a person. Luna is thinking of [[Noah and Raul|Raul]], Nova, or [[Idriel]] though Orion only has to guess twice. Correctly answering both wins favor. Orion then attempts to play the game, but is immediately thwarted when Luna correctly guesses he is thinking of either her or her father.

You then stop at a gas station. Luna's father prepays for the gas while Luna waits in the car and Orion takes a moment to stand in the rain and think, before noticing an Exit Portal that has somehow appeared in the real world. He spins to catch a whisper, repeatedly and unsuccessfully, before having a vision of Calypso threatening a bar owner for daring to make her pay for her drink. He's pulled back to the real world by Luna, who notes he might be suffering from Eternum Bleeding, a condition where the real and virtual worlds cross over. Mr. Hernandez returns from the store with two large bags of coal and the drive continues. Luna rests her head on Orion's shoulder, and the player can gain favor by moving his arm around her before they both fall asleep.

The mountain is revealed to be a luxury mansion as the adult men greet each other in Spanish with familiar insults. [[Hugo]], Luna's uncle, mistakenly identifies you as her boyfriend. The player can play along to gain favor. [[Luna's Grandmother]] then shows up to greet everyone, though she's less physically kind to both of the older men. Mr. Hernandez briefly takes you aside to ask what your intentions with his daughter are, and the player can confirm whether they intend to date her or simply remain friends. He suddenly threatens Orion to take good care of Luna, before continuing the conversation as if nothing happened.

Orion changes into swimwear, then notes that he's become more physically fit despite spending less time at the gym than in Europe. He theorises that Eternum could be having an impact on his real self. The player can decide whether to send a photo to Chang or Annie, to verify whether Orion has in fact changed. Luna has already changed into her swimsuit as Orion arrives at the pool, though their conversation is interrupted by Pancho, Hugo's chicken, landing on her head. The chicken joins them in the pool, and the player can take the opportunity to get to know Luna better. If she takes her gloves off, Luna will lay her hands on Orion, and the two share a short intimate moment. Luna's grandma appears and calls her inside to have Día de los Muertos makeup applied.

Pancho steals some blue cheese. 
[[File:Luna and Orion with the makeup on.png|thumb|Luna and Orion with the makeup]]
Orion is invited to also join in the tradition. Luna's grandmother rapidly applies makeup to your face, before placing you and Luna together to have your photos taken. The player can grab Luna by the waist to gain favor, and can then choose to join Luna's grandmother at the ofrenda, a traditional altar made to honour the dead. She talks of Olivia, Luna's mother, and of her sister, who she claims can speak to the dead. The player can choose to say a few words in Olivia's honour before Luna arrives at the door, calling them both for dinner. 

Hugo claims to be a human trafficking ringleader, as well as running a cartel, though later admits the trafficking part was a lie. Mr. Hernandez shows photos of Luna when she was younger; she protests, and asks to move on to the food. If the player chose extra spicy food earlier, they are punished for their hubris. After a few hours, Orion is exposed as having drank two whole cartons of milk during lunch. Luna excuses herself and Orion joins her in the bedroom, noting that she's returned to wearing her bikini. The player can offer her a massage that becomes intimate, though attempting to make it too sensual too quickly will end it early. The scene ends when Mr. Hernandez loudly honks his horn, looking for Orion.

If Orion turns back after leaving the house, Luna is waiting behind him and expresses her gratitude for spending the day with her. Orion and Mr. Hernandez return to Kredon.

== Home ==
Orion has three texts to catch up on, with Luna, Nova, and Annie (may vary based on route). Nova, having left the house recently, announces her return by scaring Orion, then shows him her drawing: a manga comic depicting a dramatized form of their encounter with Thanatos. Expressing love for the comic gains favour, and Nova gives you the comic to keep.

Orion, while taking a shower, is met by Penelope asking to enter to grab a few bottles. If the player accepts, she spends a minute or two flirting heavily with Orion, lathering her words with innuendo and confirming he's allowed to enter the bathroom while she's showering (exclusively for urgent reasons, like grabbing a conditioner bottle).

Orion dresses as Eros, the Greek god of love, where Penelope becomes [[Idriel]]. She stops for a moment to insinuate that she might like to be the Psyche to his Eros, before the two of them leave for the party. On the way there, Nova joins the group by slingshotting Orion in the back of the head, revealing a near-flawless [https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx#Anarchist_ Jinx] cosplay. Penelope gets Orion to take a picture of the two women for an Instagram post.
== Costume Party - Beginning ==
[[File:Penny tells Nova she has a crush on Orion.png|thumb|Penny tells Nova she has a crush on Orion]]
[[Orion Richards (MC)|Orion]], [[Penelope Carter|Penelope]], and [[Nova Johnson|Nova]] arrive at the costume party inside a college dorm. Orion must first talk to [[Judith]], the event organizer, before gaining access to the party. While Orion goes to talk to Judith, Nova and Penelope comment and admire on Orion and his Eros cosplay. Penelope then secretly confesses to Nova that she has a crush on Orion after the shower incident. Nova, after pondering on what Penelope has to say, reluctantly comes to the realization that she too has a crush on Orion. Because Orion is not yet a college student, he pays Judith 49 Eternals for access to the party. After complimenting Penelope, Judith mistakenly also tries to charge Nova, not recognizing her. Judith only recognizes her after Nova mentions an accident at school. Penelope and Nova introduce Orion to their friends. Nova's friends did attend the party, whereas Penelope is aggressively dragged away by another college student for a picture. Nova hears about a competition with a prize of a $4,000 processor, the best on the market, and forces Orion to compete with her for it. 

Orion can either go to Penelope or Nova in the party from here on out. If Orion chooses to go to Penelope first, he can fail the challenge with Nova.

=== Nova's Competition ===
The competition for the processor is hosted by [[Akira]], who plans to give it away as it is no longer of use to him. Before allowing them in, Akira quizzes them on the different types of a socket on a CPU. Orion panics, not knowing how to respond, but Nova quickly and coherently explains the answer to his quiz. Nova and Orion must compete against another pair of contestants ([[Haskel and Dolores]])  in a 90 minute and five game challenge.

==== The First Challenge ====
[[File:Nova can't even finish one beer.png|thumb|Nova can't even finish one beer]]
For the first challenge, the team who is able to drink the most bottles of beer within 10 minutes. The challenge begins, and immediately Nova cannot finish even a single bottle, relying on Orion, who has finished 5 beers so far. Dolores and Haskel mock Nova and Orion for not being able to drink. If Orion continues to drink, he will pass out and be unable to continue the challenge. Otherwise, Nova and Orion fail the first challenge, but will be able to compete again in the subsequent challenges. 

==== The Second Challenge ====
For the second challenge, each team must find the biggest sized bra in 10 minutes. Orion must then find Penelope in the locker room, who has been "accidentally" doused in alcohol by [[Regina]]. Although Penelope's dress is ruined, she gives Orion her bra, teasing him in the meanwhile. Returning to the challenge, Akira, Haskel, and Dolores are shocked by its size, which wins the second challenge.

==== The Third Challenge ====
For the third challenge, the contestants are bound to an advanced polygraph, determining results solely on voice. Each team must converse and respond to Akira's questions for five minutes without telling ten lies in total. Dolores and Haskel are asked simple questions first, while Nova is asked a lewd question. She panics, and tells a lie in the process. Dolores answers honestly, while Akira keeps pushing. Reluctantly, Nova once again falsely lies about the question, and gets a 2nd mark. Afterwards, she slowly answers truthfully. 

Akira continues to directly respond to Nova's questions, panicking her further and she lies a third time. Dolores personally questions Nova after, who confesses that she would be interested in Penelope if she had to. Nova claims to have seen images on Penelope's laptop, where Dolores asks if she's a hacker. Nova denies, which results in her being penalized again. 

Dolores and Haskel then talk between each other, but Dolores lies when she says she would give her laptop to Haskel, marking them down. Akira then questions Dolores directly. He asks how many other boys she has been with, to which Dolores lies to Haskel, penalizing them again. She continues to deny, which leads to another four marks taken off of them. In frustration, Dolores questions Nova and Orion about their relationship, believing them to be dating. When told otherwise, she continuously questions Nova about the intimate parts of her life. Nova keeps evading and gets marked six times in a row, losing them the challenge. Due to the drama caused by the machine, Nova claims the machine doesn't work, to everyone's agreement. 

==== The Fourth Challenge ====
Everyone must enter Eternum for the fourth challenge. While commenting on the E-suit, Nova and Dolores go back and forth, bickering about each other's bodies. Orion is asked on which of the two look better by Nova and Dolores. Orion will compliment Nova, but if he decides to call her "his girl", he will gain favor with Nova. Haskel will compliment Dolores, to which Orion mocks. 
[[File:Nova fires a rocket at the other team.png|thumb|Nova fires a rocket at the other team]]
In Eternum, Nova and Orion focus on their surroundings, before making small talk with each other. Akira shows up in a drone, who gives the challenge's instructions. In a 2 mile map wide, they must eliminate the other team in 30 minutes. This server is a training server, so the normal penalties that apply to dying in Eternum are not applicable here. They are also allowed to use any weapon in their inventory. Orion initially tries to strategize, but Nova immediately transforms [[Dione]] into an RPG-7, blowing up the other team across the map. After the victory, Dolores praises Nova for the shot, before saying that she deserves the processor. Dolores decides to drop out of the competition as a result. Despite there being six games left and to Haskel's disappointment, he has no choice but to follow Dolores. Nova celebrates, but Akira puts up a final challenge to prove if Nova and Orion are worthy of winning.  

==== The Fifth Challenge ====
For the fifth challenge, Orion and Nova must prove they are capable of controlling their impulses. They must stay away from each other while locked alone in a library, validated by Akira's machine that detects if the two implants in their brains get too close. Akira makes them consume an exotic wine, claiming it to be aphrodisiac. Scattered around the library are accessories, possibly meant to encourage Orion and Nova to fail. 

10 minutes pass, and Orion is immediately shown struggling. The same is shown with Nova, who also has great difficulty suppressing herself. Nova and Orion talk to each other on what they're feeling, and think back to what happened in the Egyptian server. If Orion complements Nova on what happened in Egypt, he'll gain favor with her. Orion can brings up an idea to satisfy themselves in order to last until the end of the challenge.  They are interrupted by Akira, who announces outside that they have won the challenge. Akira then seemingly reveals that the exotic wine was just a placebo, only consisting of sugar and juice. After, Akira again reveals that it was not a placebo, and the wine was an extremely powerful aphrodisiac, not recommended to be drank with alcohol. Nova runs to the bathroom because of the side effects, and they win the challenge.

=== Truth or Dare ===
[[File:Regina poured beer on Penny.png|thumb|Regina poured beer on Penny]]
While waiting for Penelope, Orion is approached by Regina, who "accidentally" soaked Penelope with alcohol earlier. Regina will insult Penelope while talking to Orion, disagreeing with what she has to say. When Penelope arrives, Regina comments about Penelope's outfit, saying it isn't a costume. Penelope passive aggressively responds to Regina, subtly blaming her for ruining it. 

Penelope is suddenly complemented by [[Charlotte]], who is also at the party. Orion recognizes and calls her out, Charlotte, initially not recognizing Orion, says that she wants to party and to take notes from Penelope. Orion comments on [[Axel Bardot|Axel]], to which she says Axel doesn't come to school, doesn't respond to her on social media, and is always offline. Charlotte complains about how her school year has been disastrous so far, where Orion cannot relate.

Penelope takes a seat next to Orion, while interpreting his comment to Charlotte as being the result of her family, which Orion vaguely agrees. Regina objects to Penelope, saying that she wanted to sit next to Orion. Once again, Regina and Penelope continue another round of passive aggressive comments. Afterwards, Regina reveals a bottle of Jägermeister for the group to drink. A few minutes later, the mood has lightened, and [[Professor Connor]], who is also partying, has joined the group. They play a game of Truth or Dare, with Orion being the first one questioned. 

==== '''Truth''' ====
Regina asks how big Orion's ''<small>accessories</small>'' are, of which Orion's answers shocks Regina. Regina also takes the opportunity to make a comment about Penelope.

==== '''Dare''' ====
Regina dares Orion to kiss Penelope on the neck. Orion enthusiastically accepts, and does it. Orion will also gain favor with Penelope as a result.

==== The Game Continues ====
Continuing, Penelope initially dares Professor Connor, but he refuses. Penelope then asks if he had slept with the Dean, to which Professor Connor hints that he did by confirming or denying. Charlotte next asks Penelope which two people she would be intimate with at the party. Penelope's first answer is Nova, who Charlotte and Regina don't know, and they discuss Nova's costume. 

Professor Connor's turn is next, and he chooses Orion, as he wants to know his future students better.

==== '''Truth''' ====
Professor Connor asks if Orion has been intimate with a woman during her period, to which Orion says no. Penelope then asks if Orion would hypothetically do it. She'll compliment Orion if he says no, but will playfully make fun of him if he does.

==== '''Dare''' ====
Professor Connor dares Orion to take a magic mushroom. Orion tries to refuse, but Professor Connor reassures and pressures Orion to take one. Orion then hallucinates and becomes disorientated. Orion then sees everyone is gone, and only Idriel sits next to him, beckoning him to return to Eternum, and asking him to call the coin again.

Orion recovers from the mushrooms, and the game continues. Next, the unnamed College Student asks Penelope where the weirdest place she was intimate with herself, to which she says inside a jacuzzi at a spa with Dalia and Nancy. Next, Orion can dare Penelope, Regina, or Charlotte.

==== '''Penelope''' ====
Orion dares Penelope to flash someone at the group, to which she chooses Charlotte. Charlotte is amazed and jealous after as a result.

==== '''Regina''' ====
Orion dares Regina to flash someone at the group, to which she chooses Orion. Orion compliments Regina, much to Penelope's discontent. Orion will also lose one favor with Penelope.

==== '''Charlotte''' ====
Orion dares Charlotte to flash someone at the group, to which she chooses Orion. Orion is turned off and negatively thinks poorly of the moment. 

==== End of the Game ====
The game of Truth or Dare has ended, and Regina apologizes to Professor Connor about losing the yearbook. Regina and Penelope start to bicker again, while Orion asks for context. Penelope explains that a yearbook for the year is published, and every student puts something in it. Regina claims Penelope lost it, but Penelope claims it was stolen from her bag. Once everyone has left, Penelope, with hesitation, reveals that she suspects Regina of stealing the book, and wants to steal it from her dorm. Orion can choose to help steal it, or discourage her from going.

== Sneaking into the Dorm ==
[[File:Penny and Orion breaking into Regina's dorm.png|thumb|Penny and Orion breaking into Regina's dorm]]
Penelope and Orion sneak into the dorm room, where they mock Regina's rooms and her Instagram posts. They both then look through the room for the yearbook. They find a locked cabinet, but before they can steal it, Regina returns to the dorm. Panicking, they initially think to jump out the window, but instead they both hide in the small wardrobe. 

After Regina leaves to dispose of the yearbook, they both fall out of the wardrobe. Orion has an accident, which arouses Penelope. They then are intimate with each other in Regina's dorm, before leaving to find Nova.

== Home ==
[[File:The goodnight kiss.png|thumb|The goodnight kiss]]
Orion walks Nova home, then gets home with Penelope. Orion and Penelope talk about dancing, and kiss before going to sleep. Orion barely gets any sleep before Nancy wakes him up to go to the office. Before arriving at the office, they stop for coffee to wake Orion up.  

== Office ==
They arrive at [[Nancy's Office]] and Orion followed her into the elevator as she hit the second-floor button, explaining the building’s four above-ground floors and thirteen hidden underground levels used for parking, storage, and labs she no longer had access to since [[Ulysses]] took over. She mentioned how empty Sundays usually were, but the elevator suddenly stopped and opened to [[Gertrude]], who was muttering about extra work before switching to cheerful bragging about her husband, her son’s "Ethernium "addiction, and her hopes for a promotion. Nancy awkwardly played along, but things got tense when Gertrude greeted Orion as if he were Nancy’s daughter, Dalia. From here, Orion could either play along with her mistake or correct her.

=== Gertrude ===

==== If Orion Plays Along ====
Orion kept the act going, thanking Gertrude and saying he was excited to see where his “mom” worked. Gertrude loved it, talking about empowered women and how much “Dalia” would learn by watching them. Nancy explained they came on a Sunday because weekdays were too hectic, and Gertrude praised her for the smart choice. She then launched into a whole bit about supporting “Dalia’s” decisions, mentioning her PTA work, a TikTok campaign, and even asking if Orion wanted to join their dancing videos. He politely turned it down. Gertrude wished them well and said she was terribly busy, tossing in a comment about Nancy falling behind lately. Nancy asked her to let them know if the Ulysses rep arrived, and Gertrude agreed before heading off. Once they reached Nancy’s office and closed the door, she sighed, saying that was way too close. Orion told her they’d be fine since Gertrude didn’t seem too sharp, and after she laughed, he called her “Mommy”, asking what her plan actually was. (playing along enables "Mommy" name play)

==== If Orion Corrects Her ====
Orion finally snapped and spelled it out for Gertrude, telling her to watch his lips as he said he wasn’t Dalia, wasn’t a girl, wasn’t Nancy’s kid, and that his name was Orion. She brushed it off, saying he could identify however he wanted, which only made him more frustrated as he insisted he was born male. Gertrude froze, then blew up, accusing him of lying and calling him transphobic. Orion was completely baffled, trying to explain he hadn’t lied at all, but she kept twisting everything, calling him misogynistic and blaming Nancy for his “values.” Nancy awkwardly backed her up, saying she brought him to learn tolerance and that seeing empowered women at work might help. Gertrude loved that idea and then reminded Nancy she’d been falling behind lately. Nancy asked her to notify them if the Ulysses rep arrived, and Gertrude agreed before leaving. Once they made it to Nancy’s office and closed the door, Orion whistled at the room while Nancy said that was way too close. He told her they’d be fine since Gertrude wasn’t exactly sharp, and she laughed before he asked what her actual plan was. (correcting her disables "Mommy" name play)

=== The Plan ===
Orion listens as Nancy explains that she and Nova actually managed to create a piece of malware that can steal a player’s Eternum inventory, though it has to be physically connected to the target’s E-visor and later retrieved. She kept it secret so she could surprise him. Then she shifts to a bigger plan. Every Sunday, a Ulysses representative named [[Clarence Ruiz]] comes to collect weekly data, and Nancy believes his laptop contains the records of the first people to ever find each Gem. Since Thanatos discovered the first Gem of Doom, Nancy thinks this is their chance to uncover his real identity or at least get a strong lead.

Nancy outlines the whole setup using objects in the office as stand-ins. Clarence always arrives through one elevator, and she plans to call him away to the front desk so he’ll pass their room and leave his laptop open. That will give Orion about seven or eight minutes to sneak into the office, look for anything related to Thanatos or the Gems, and then leave through the other elevator so he won’t run into him on the way back. She reminds Orion that Clarence usually leaves his laptop unlocked when he steps out.
[[File:Nancy threatens the ERE leader.png|thumb|Nancy threatens the ERE leader]]
While they wait, Nancy talks about how she recently got the Eastern Roman Empire to join the WRE. She describes the confrontation with their leader, Cicero, and how she pressured him into surrendering after he refused to negotiate. Before they can say much more, Gertrude walks in and announces that Clarence has arrived. Nancy quickly covers, sends Gertrude out with her to get donuts, and leaves Orion hidden in the room to wait for his moment.  

=== The Execution ===
Once Clarence leaves his office, Orion moves fast. He slips inside and finds the laptop open just like Nancy said. He searches everything he can: emails, folders, reports, and anything that might hold Gem information. At first there’s nothing, but then he finds the G.O.D. reports listing the discovery of each Gem. He spots his own info from when he found the Seventh Gem, which explains how Thanatos tracked him so quickly back then. Finally he finds what they’ve been looking for: the first Gem’s discoverer, complete with personal details and Eternum ID. Realizing they’ve just uncovered Thanatos’s real identity, Orion knows he needs to get out before Clarence returns, though part of him wonders if he should try to grab anything else before leaving.

=== Clarence's Laptop ===

==== Other Gem Owners ====
If Orion chooses to look here, he sees a list of the first owners of each Gem. Some names are familiar, like Sugawara Tsuneo and Connor M. Kuvner, while others aren’t. He realizes that many of these Gems were stolen by Thanatos long ago, including the Gem of Doom he currently holds. Even the second and third Gems, owned by A. Lopes and K. Dixon, are now in Thanatos’s possession. This option helps Orion understand how Thanatos collected the Gems, but it doesn’t reveal anything about future events or the Founder.

==== Next Ulysses Event ====
If Orion investigates this section, he discovers information about an upcoming special event in December called “The Big Hunt.” The prize is still listed as TBD, but he knows that past events have given valuable rewards, like swords Annie won. Choosing this option gives Orion a glimpse into future Ulysses activities, but it doesn’t provide details about the other Gem owners or the Founder.

==== The Founder ====
If Orion decides to check this option, he finds a notarized contract stating that the person who collects all ten Gems will become the owner of Ulysses and its new CEO. While there are no loopholes and the language is straightforward, it doesn’t explain the Founder’s motivations. Choosing this option provides insight into the ultimate stakes of the Gem hunt, but he won’t learn about other players or upcoming events.

=== Clarence Comes Back ===
Right after Orion finishes checking the file he chose, Clarence Ruiz walks back into the office and catches him at the laptop. Clarence demands to know who he is and accuses him of trying to steal classified information. Orion tries to talk his way out of it, but Clarence cuts him off and brings up the Founder, which only confuses Orion more. Clarence gets more agitated, saying the police can’t know and that Orion isn’t leaving the building because his boss can’t find out about this mistake.
[[File:Nancy hits Clarence with a baseball bat.png|thumb|Nancy hits Clarence with a baseball bat]]
As Clarence steps toward him, his tone turns threatening, and Orion realizes this is getting dangerous fast. Just as Clarence reaches for him, Nancy appears behind him and knocks him out with a baseball bat. Orion jumps back, and Nancy quickly checks on him, apologizing because she thought Clarence would head to the front desk instead of returning to the office. Orion tells her he’s okay and thanks her for saving him. 

Nancy checks Clarence and says he’ll probably be out for a while, but they should tie him up just to be safe. Orion helps her muzzle him and bind his hands and feet. Nancy tells Clarence to stay quiet, and Orion sighs, admitting this was not part of the plan. Nancy apologizes for the mess, but she’s confident they won’t get in trouble since only Gertrude knew Orion was there, and she already sent her away. She also doubts Clarence will contact security, given his pride and fear of his superiors. Still, she says they should leave the building immediately.

=== Nancy and Orion Get Out of There ===
On the way out, Orion points out that the mission was still a success because he uncovered Thanatos’s real identity. Nancy celebrates the news, and Orion explains he found everything: the name, the ID number, and even the address. Nancy jokes about needing to fly somewhere far, but Orion tells her Thanatos lives in Evergreen, Washington, which is only about a five hour drive. They both realize they’re thinking the same thing. Orion suggests they head there now to plant Nova’s device and catch him off guard. Nancy is tempted, and Orion admits he also has a personal score to settle. They agree the mission continues and head out together.

On the elevator to the parking garage, Orion confirms which floor the car is on and recaps what they know: Thanatos’ identity, the Gems of Doom they could collect, and the remaining Gems in Eternum.

Nancy responds quietly, reflecting on her experiences and how she’s sometimes acted without considering Orion. He admits he knows what he wants and that he wants to be with her. She mentions their age difference, her daughters, her past as his former nanny, her job, and the complications of Eternum and Ulysses. She also notes how they’ve often been interrupted, as if something always stops them from taking the next step.

Orion protests the idea of destiny. Nancy presses the elevator’s emergency stop, then declares that if destiny won’t give her an opportunity, she’ll create her own and that she wants Orion. This transitions into Orion and Nancy's second romantic scene. 

Nancy and Orion hurriedly get dressed when the elevator arrives. Gertrude appears, retrieving a binder she forgot, and they exchange quick apologies and goodbyes. Gertrude notices Nancy left her shoes behind, and Orion points out there’s an extra pair in the car. After a brief acknowledgment, Nancy and Orion leave, while Gertrude heads back to her car, muttering about the elevators and Nancy’s forgetfulness. 

== The Abandoned House ==
Orion wakes up as Nancy tells him they’ve arrived. He realizes he slept through most of the drive and quickly remembers why they came. Nancy jokes that he needed the rest, and Orion stretches, feeling refreshed. They confirm they are at the address thought to be [[Wyatt's House|Thanatos' House]] but the house looks abandoned and isolated. With no other vehicles around and the door unlocked, they decide to take a quick look inside.

The interior is decayed and filled with abandoned belongings, making it unclear whether the place was deserted suddenly or if someone still lives there. They search upstairs but find only empty rooms. Disappointed, Nancy sits down, convinced the trip was a dead end. Orion reminds her that they still gained valuable information and suggests calling Nova to see if she can find a more recent address.
[[File:Orion calls Nova.png|thumb|Orion calls Nova]]
Nova answers immediately. Nancy explains the situation and gives her the name and details they found. After a brief search, Nova confirms that Wyatt R. Pitman is not Thanatos and reveals that he died five years ago. She suspects Thanatos used the identity of a dead person to cover his tracks, possibly with help from Ulysses. With no new lead, Nancy thanks Nova and ends the call. 

As they prepare to leave, an [[Wyatt's Mother|elderly woman]] suddenly confronts them with a shotgun, demanding to know why they’re in her house. Nancy quickly explains the mistake and apologizes, revealing they were looking for her son. The woman confirms Wyatt was her son and that he passed away years ago. When Nancy mentions she is also a mother, the woman lowers the gun, shaken and emotional. She explains she’s been alone since her son’s death and thought they were intruders.
[[File:Nancy comforts Wyatt's mother.png|thumb|Nancy comforts Wyatt's mother]]
Nancy comforts her, apologizing again and offering her phone number in case she ever needs someone to talk to. The woman thanks her and asks them to leave. As they turn to go, Orion notices a photo of Wyatt and asks about it. The woman explains a little about her son, including his size, interests, and that he died from a sudden stroke. She adds that he passed away while doing what he loved most, playing Eternum. 

As she finishes speaking, something clicks for Orion, triggering fragmented memories and past visions. The realization settles in quietly, heavy and unsettling, as they are about to leave, knowing this visit may not have been pointless after all.
